2645-3257-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3257-3430-7014.description:
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

883-3968-4050-4078.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 4 or higher.
883-3968-4050-4078.description:
Activate Chainer by paying {B}{B}{B} and 3 life, returning Grave Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grave Titan enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Grave Titan and the two Zombies, adding {B}{B}{B}
When Grave Titan and the Zombie tokens die, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers three times, causing you to gain 1 life for each trigger.
Repeat.

339-677-728-3480.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

222-527-728-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-2279-3125-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2279-3125-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1084-6012.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two other creatures with toughness equal to 1.
You have a way to put a -1/-1 counter on a creature.
1084-6012.description:
Put a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1. The creatue dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, triggering Flourishing Defenses and Reluctant Role Model.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature you control with toughness equal to 1.
Resolve the Flourishing Defenses trigger, creating a 1/1 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
1084-6012.notes: You can alternatively start the combo with one creature that has toughness equal to 1 and another creature that has a -1/-1 counter on it. If you do, kill the creature with a -1/-1 counter on it to start the combo.

3480-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3480-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3480-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2173-2438-5220-6772.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing it.
When Carrion Feeder dies, Mortuary and Syr Vondam trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Carrion Feeder from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and putting a +1/+1 counter on Syr Vondam.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Carrion Feeder from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2653-2893-4136-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Roaring Earth trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Roaring Earth trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2292-5220-6538-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

1744-3604-6567.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1744-3604-6567.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 70 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

1651-5469-6291.description:
Activate Transmutation Font's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and your choice of a Clue, Food or Blood artifact token
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Transmutation Font.
Repeat.

2440-4404-5663--108.notablePrerequisites: You control a token copy of Corridor Monitor
2440-4404-5663--108.description:
Activate Cayth by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Corridor Monitor token.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cayth
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a type with the Corridor Monitor token.
Repeat.
2440-4404-5663--108.notes: You must choose a card from the template that can make a token copy of Corridor Monitor.

1618-2104-6496--97.easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
1618-2104-6496--97.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Temporal Manipulation and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
1618-2104-6496--97.description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Temporal Manipulation and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Temporal Manipulation and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Temporal Manipulation's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
1618-2104-6496--97.notes: It is highly recommended to choose a self-suspending card that you are certain will have legal targets, if applicable, every time it is cast.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3090-3967-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Harmless Offering.
3090-3967-5434-5555.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Yahenni by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-1336-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Heronblade Elite and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-1336-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

3750-6190.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
3750-6190.description:
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Shadow of the Second Sun triggers, causing you to get an additional beginning phase after this phase.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to the main phase from step 5.
At the beginning of the main phase, Shadow of the Second Sun triggers, causing you to get an additional beginning phase after this phase.
Move to the beginning phase from step 7, causing you to untap all lands you control and draw a card.
Move to the main phase from step 4.
Repeat from step 2.

2436-2608-4499.notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness, and has power 3 or greater.
2436-2608-4499.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat.

413-891-2386-5220.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Boonweaver Giant.
413-891-2386-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant.
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Mortuary and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Boonweaver Giant from your library onto the battlefield.
When Boonweaver Giant enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 5, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2544-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least four.
2544-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

982-1850-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Kazandu Refuge from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Kazandu Refuge, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Kazandu Refuge trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

2020-2430-2670-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Vadrik has power 4 or greater.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
2020-2430-2670-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {U}, and choosing to pay an additional {U} and reveal Psychic Puppetry from your hand, adding Psychic Puppetry's effects to Petals of Insight.
Resolve Petals of Insight, looking at the top three cards of your library, putting them on the bottom of your library, untapping Nykthos, and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.
If your devotion to blue is at least five, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may target any permanent using Psychic Puppetry's effect.

4067-4436-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have had at least three creatures die under your control this turn.
4067-4436-4499.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Liliana's Standard Bearer.
When Liliana's Standard Bearer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card for each creature that died under your control this turn.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate the mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 4 until you have at least {3} in your mana pool.
If you had additional creatures die this turn and/or the mana-producing permanent produces at least {2}, this combo nets near-infinite mana and near-infinite card draw.

1636-2467-4465-4587-5072.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
At most two mana of any two different colors available, plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
1636-2467-4465-4587-5072.description:
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Cast Sliver Grandmother from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Sliver Grandmother enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers.
Holding priortiy, activate Sliver Gravemother by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Activate Sliver Gravemother by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Choose not to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Sliver Gravemother's encore ability by paying {5} and exiling it.
Choose to return Sliver Gravemother to the command zone from exile.
Resolve the Sliver Gravemother ability, creating a token copy of it for each opponent you have.
When the Sliver Gravemother tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate the Sliver Gravemother tokens by tapping them, adding at least three mana of any color(s).
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate all Slivers you control by tapping them, adding one mana of any color for each Sliver tapped this way.
Repeat from step 15 for each remaining trigger.
Repeat from step 1.

1636-4300-4826-4913.notablePrerequisites:
Zimone and Dina does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic land.
Archelos is untapped.
1636-4300-4826-4913.description:
Activate a basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the basic land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
When the Illusion enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Zimone and Dina by tapping it and sacrificing the Illusion, causing you to draw a card and put the basic land from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos, and then repeat this process once if you control eight or more lands, putting any other land from your hand onto the battlefield instead.
Repeat.

913-1967-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Goblins.
913-1967-2440.description:
Activate Ardoz by paying {3}{R}, creating a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
The Goblin enters the battlefield, triggering Ardoz and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Ardoz trigger, giving the Goblin +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1229-1981-4050-4498.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
1229-1981-4050-4498.description:
Activate Pestilence by paying {B}, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2034-2558-4139.description:
Activate Thopter Foundry by paying {1} and sacrificing Sword of the Meek, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and gaining 1 life.
The Thopter token enters the battlefield, triggering Sword of the Meek, returning Sword of the Meek to the battlefield equipped to the Thopter.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
